scope: Independent symbolic transition expectations; no public account API, native mechanism, universal limit or runtime qualification. Selected resource profile must map each symbolic producer to original evidence.
accountingMeaning: Admission counts spent plus pending work. These tiny independent fixture ceilings replace no production profile. Cleanup costs have a separately pre-reserved profile. RA cases are independent unless an action explicitly references an earlier unresolved attempt.

cases.action: Reserve bounded work 30, submit and settle at full reserved charge; retain 20 additional bytes; confirm savepoint rollback and buffer release
cases.oracle: Rollback removes the additional retained occupancy but preserves all 30 spent work units.

cases.action: Atomically request 20 retained bytes and 11 work units before any submission
cases.oracle: Work would exceed 100; no occupancy/work reservation is partially applied.

cases.action: Reserve 10 work units and submit; completion and buffer release are unknown
cases.oracle: The complete reserved charge remains pending; no ordinary retry, refund or buffer reclamation follows.

cases.action: Reconstruct assembly around the same original issuer while RA03 remains unresolved
cases.oracle: A facade does not establish a new epoch or fresh budget.

cases.action: Perform one previously reserved qualified containment command and confirm original completion
cases.oracle: Containment consumes its own permit; it neither replenishes nor borrows the ordinary work allowance. Its actual costs remain covered by the separately reserved enclosing cleanup profile.

cases.action: Two participants sharing the original issuer concurrently request 7 work units each; barrier holds settlement until both decisions are observed
cases.oracle: Exactly one reservation is admitted and the other refuses; pending reservations participate in the same 100-unit ceiling. Which participant wins is not prescribed.

cases.action: Original native evidence confirms RA03 performed its entire reserved work and confirms original savepoint containment plus buffer release
cases.oracle: Pending charge transfers once to spent, never counts twice and never disappears on rollback. Full-budget exhaustion keeps ordinary admission closed.
